dct_description_sm: Tables include totals for the United Kingdom, Great Britain and England.  11 data files (pdf format; number of logical records varies)

Aggregate statistics from the 1991 census of population and households. Tables include: resident population and area, residents by age, economic characteristics, tenure of accommodation and amenities, dwellings, household composition, ethnic group, young adults, pensioners, social class, industry and qualifications.
